pr_title: Add support for highlighting chat messages
pr_body:
Closes #17088 

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22781491/156957613-c4485659-7bfc-4418-8952-2205eee91075.mp4

I haven't thoroughly tested how this behaves yet in a real client, but I'm mostly PR'ing this for feedback on the direction and specifically the logic in chat overlay to handle highlighting messages on non-loaded `DrawableChannel`s (via `messagePendingHighlight` and `tryHighlightMessage`).

- [x] Depends on #17115 
- [x] Depends on ppy/osu-framework#5058
- [x] Depends on ppy/osu-framework#5059 (see [this](https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/30b38345aad33a37419f32528cc1ff831e70699a/osu.Game/Overlays/Chat/DrawableChannel.cs#L91) and [this](https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/30b38345aad33a37419f32528cc1ff831e70699a/osu.Game/Overlays/Chat/DrawableChannel.cs#L121))
- [x] Depends on framework bump
- [x] Pending actual game testing
pr_comments: I like the effect, it should work fine visually for now. The transition length may need to be adjusted to make sure it's visible after a longer scroll, though.

I've improved the scrolling logic to ensure the highlighted message display at the middle of chat rather than anywhere in view:

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22781491/157566893-28550563-d233-4480-98dd-8e942d5539d2.mp4

issue_context.title: Clicking a chat notification should scroll chat to the point of highlight
issue_context.body:
I think this shouldn't be too hard to make happen. I know I've run into this multiple times already (and been annoyed by it), so going to set it to p1. ### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/17078
Originally posted by **TheFantasticLoki** March 3, 2022 I got mentioned by a user while afk and when I came back I clicked the notification saying I was mentioned. It didn't take me to the message in chat nor did the notification contain the contents of the message. There also is no highlights channel in lazer atm so I had no way of reading what he said as I could not find his message in chat anywhere. I'd like to see at least a highlights channel implemented to solve this issue if not both. Also before someone comments I did MULTIPLE searches through discussions and issues with the keywords Highlight, Channel and mention and no existing threads showed for me.

review_comments: I guess we're still nulling this in the end?
Have mentioned one edge case of removing clearing this bindable in https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/17137#discussion_r824005909.
The method is already scheduled, since all usages are not safe to call it directly. I guess it's better to schedule at usages rather than in the method itself?
yeah i saw that. was more of a suggestion to avoid it running more than once, but i guess it's not the end of the world if it does.
